name: Patagopelta
isnote: The cited Wikipedia revision calls it an ankylosaurian; Riguetti et al. 2022 recovered it as a nodosaurid; placed in Nodosauridae pending later analyses.
sum: Patagopelta is a small-bodied ankylosaur from the Allen Formation of Patagonia, Argentina, with crested neck osteoderms.
holotype: MPCA-SM-78, a cervical half-ring element — Allen Formation, Salitral Moreno, Río Negro, Argentina.
material: Osteoderms, a tooth, vertebrae and femora; in 2026 more skull, limb, pelvic and armour elements were referred (Agnolín et al.).
biology: Known from armour and postcranial bones; no behavioural data in the sources used.
author: Riguetti et al. 2022
